preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of roads is exactly n - 1, where roads is the list of directed edges parsed from input.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t for s, t in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within the valid range [1, n].
The undirected version of the roads forms a tree (connected and acyclic).

postconditions.expression: min_flips == min(flips_needed(capital, roads) for capital in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: min_flips is the minimum number of road inversions required across all possible capital choices.

postconditions.expression: all(capital in possible_capitals for capital in range(1, n + 1) if flips_needed(capital, roads) == min_flips)
postconditions.description: possible_capitals contains exactly those cities for which the number of road inversions equals min_flips.
possible_capitals is a list of capital candidates sorted in increasing order.
The first line of stdout is the minimum number of road inversions (min_flips).
The second line of stdout is the space-separated list of possible capital cities in increasing order.
